title: 00 Index
subtitle: The Maude v2 "in practice" set on four boards — the request and the thirteen canvases that answer it, the rules they all follow, the open questions, and what's shared
brief: The overview Michal opens first to review the whole v2 canvases set: his request (verbatim, Czech) and the 8 Oct follow-up checked off against the canvases, a card per canvas (01–13), the cross-canvas rules (CONTRACT §6–§7), the open questions (v2-open-questions.md plus 13's round) and the shared kit.

sections.title: Maude v2 — in practice
sections.subtitle: The whole set on four boards: the map, the rules, the open questions, what's shared

artboards.label: 1 · The map — request, thirteen canvases
artboards.note: Michal's request ticked off bullet by bullet against the canvas that answers it — plus the 8 Oct follow-up (→ 13, 11 · pn-ds) — then thirteen cards in four groups, each with its question, artboard count, three artboards to start with and its file.

artboards.label: 2 · The rules every canvas follows
artboards.note: CONTRACT §6–§7 as a rule sheet in eight topics — now with the design system on a board, azure AI buttons, lower elevation and the two toolbars of §2 (Edit makes things inside artboards, incl. Image and Component; Preview only marks up); each rule says whether it is settled or proposed for Michal to confirm, and which artboard draws it.

artboards.label: 3 · Open questions for Michal
artboards.note: The eight product-model decisions up top, then six more from the latest round (13 Design System, two AI details from 03), then the features drawn as if they existed as a scope checklist, then the smaller word, key and placement calls — each with the canvas to look at.

artboards.label: 4 · What's shared — kit, video, conventions
artboards.note: The _kit.tsx components with live glyphs, thumbnails, kinds and status words; _video.tsx; the window, theme and shape conventions with every id prefix; known issues spun off as tasks.
